name: set_tooth
description: Select which tooth is being restored (Universal numbering 1-32). Only when the user names a tooth.

name: run_auto_design
description: Run the full automatic design (margin, crown, contacts, occlusion, thickness, checks). Needs scans loaded and the prep tapped or a margin already found.

name: adjust_param
description: Change one numeric design parameter, then the crown is regenerated and re-checked. mode 'change' adds value to the current setting, 'set' replaces it. Parameters (mm unless noted): contactMesialMm / contactDistalMm = target signed distance to the neighbour at the contact (negative = tighter/heavier contact, typical -0.05..0.02); occlusalClearanceMm = minimum distance to the opposing teeth (larger = lower crown, typical 0..0.2); cuspScale = cusp height multiplier (unitless, 0.6..1.4); grooveScale = groove depth multiplier (unitless, 0..2); buccalBulgeMm / lingualBulgeMm = extra contour on that side (-0.4..0.6); heightOffsetMm = raise (+) or lower (-) the occlusal table; rotationDeg = rotate anatomy about the insertion axis (degrees, + toward mesial); mdShiftMm (+ mesial) / blShiftMm (+ buccal) = shift the anatomy; cementGapMm = cement space (0.02..0.12); axisTiltMesialDeg / axisTiltBuccalDeg = lean the path of insertion toward mesial/buccal (degrees, -15..15; changes undercut blockout).

name: set_material
description: Set the restoration material. This sets minimum thicknesses and the cement gap from the lab's material presets.

name: set_occlusal_contacts
description: Whether the design raises cusp tips into contact with the opposing teeth (true, normal) or leaves the crown out of occlusion (false).

name: sculpt
description: Add (+) or remove (-) material at a named region along the surface normal with a smooth falloff. Cusp names depend on the tooth (molars: mesiobuccal, distobuccal, distal (lower only), mesiolingual, distolingual; premolars: buccal, lingual; canine: cusp tip; incisors: incisal edge). Contacts, occlusion and minimum thickness are re-enforced afterwards, so to change contact tightness or occlusal height prefer adjust_param.

amount_mm.description: Millimetres, between -1 and 1. Typical edits are 0.05-0.3.

radius_mm.description: Falloff radius in millimetres, between 0.5 and 4. 1.5 is a cusp-sized edit.

name: flip_buccal
description: Flip which side is buccal (use when the user says the buccal/lingual orientation is reversed).

name: set_view
description: Point the camera at the crown from a side.

name: set_layer
description: Show or hide a display layer: antagonist (opposing scan), scan (prep arch), heatmap (wall thickness colours), margin (margin line), crown.

name: get_checks
description: Return the current quality-check report (thickness, contacts, occlusion, undercuts, margin confidence, orientation) with measured values.
